text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale General holds 364.25 units of clopidogrel bisulfate (26.2 days on hand). Corvale Lakeside holds 23 units of the 300 mg/1 strength (8.9 days on hand). The drug is not on the FDA drug shortage list as of this date.

Why (FDA record): FDA records show clopidogrel bisulfate is not listed on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply at Corvale Lakeside is below the two-week target. Corvale General has sufficient inventory to support a transfer. Multiple distributors have product available and are not on the FDA shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 14 units from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Place an order with Proficient Rx LP — requires buyer approval; last FDA inspection VAI 2022-12-08.
3. Place an order with A-S Medication Solutions — requires buyer approval; label does not name a manufacturing plant.
4. Place an order with American Health Packaging — requires buyer approval; label does not name a manufacturing plant.
5. Place an order with Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC — requires buyer approval; label does not name a manufacturing plant.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
